name: LT1057 / LT1058
tagline: Linear Tech's fast, precise JFET dual and quad. Chinese and Korean rollers call it cold, fast and resolving.

lineage.note: Original LTC datasheet code 10578f*. Introduction year unconfirmed.
Rehosts datasheet 10578fd; lt1057.html and lt1058.html product pages are live.

part_numbers.note: Dual, standard 8-pin pinout, PDIP and SO. ADI product page live.
8-pin PDIP; LT1057ACN8#PBF and LT1057CN8#PBF listed. 'ACN' probably shorthand.
SO-8. Leaded IS8 and IS8#TR discontinued by PDN 25_0027; #PBF versions replace.
'Gold can' prized by HIFIDIY users. LT1057MH/883 listed; ACH/CH codes unconfirmed.
Wide SO-16 dual, in a distributor listing; package per suffix convention.
Quad, standard 14-pin pinout. ADI product page live.
Wide SO-16. LT1058ISW obsolete (PDN 25_0024); #TRPBF named replacement.

key_specs.value: 14 V/µs typ, 10 V/µs min; settles 1.3 µs to 0.02%
50 pA (CN hobby sources quote about 60 pA)

reputation.summary: Praise comes mainly from Chinese and Korean op-amp rollers. Baidu Tieba's 40-op-amp roundup credits it with extension, speed and dynamics but a cool tone and slightly recessed mids. HIFIDIY users call the gold-can version resolving but 'cold' and roll it beside the OPA2111HK. EET-China, digipine and sounting.com echo this. All subjective.
typical_uses: DAC I/V and output stage rolling (DIY)
Headphone amp and preamp socket upgrades
caveats: Praise is regional (CN/KR forums) and subjective; no Western consensus found.
The 'cold' voicing may not suit systems that are already bright.
Metal-can versions are old or NOS stock, with counterfeit and remark risk.
JFET bias current rises with temperature (50 pA specified at 70 °C).

counterfeit_notes: No LT1057-specific fake reports known. Sought-after TO-5 and early DIP parts are NOS, sold via Taobao, eBay and brokers. Distrust cheap 'gold cans'; check marking, date codes, offset and bias current against the datasheet.

silicon_changes.summary: ADI PCNs 22_0241 and 22_0254 (Rev. - and A) change the die-attach epoxy from Henkel 8290 to 8290A for 8-lead SOIC; LT1057 and LT1058 order codes are listed among affected parts.
silicon_changes.identification: Not marked on the part; date code after the PCN effective date. PCN 22_0172 also surfaces for LT1057, scope unseen.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: same die, pinout and specification.
silicon_changes.verification: Seen in search snippets; exact LT1057/LT1058 order codes in each PCN not checked.

silicon_changes.summary: PDN 25_0024 discontinues LT1058ISW (replacement LT1058ISW#TRPBF); PDN 25_0027 discontinues LT1057IS8 and LT1057IS8#TR (replacements #PBF and #TRPBF, pin-compatible). Lead-finish and packaging codes only.
silicon_changes.identification: Discontinued codes lack the #PBF suffix; replacements are Pb-free versions of the same part.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: same part in Pb-free finish, pin-to-pin per the PDN.
silicon_changes.verification: PDN parts tables seen in snippets; notice dates not shown (year from number).

claims_confirmed: Legacy LTC CDN copy of rev D: https://cds.linear.com/docs/en/datasheet/10578fd.pdf
14 V/µs (10 V/µs min), 5 MHz GBW, 1.3 µs settling to 0.02%: https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/10578fd.pdf
Offset 150/450 µV (LT1057), 180/600 µV (LT1058); bias 50 pA at 70 °C: https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/10578fd.pdf
Noise 13 nV/√Hz at 1 kHz, 26 nV/√Hz at 10 Hz: https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/10578fd.pdf
LT1057 is a matched JFET dual (8-pin); LT1058 the lowest-offset quad JFET in 14-pin pinout: https://www.farnell.com/datasheets/514478.pdf

Revision suffixes 10578fa, fb, fc and fd all exist on mirror copies (https://dtsheet.com/model/2309240, https://html.alldatasheet.com/html-pdf/257513/LINER/LT1057_1/779/5/LT1057_1.html, https://www.farnell.com/datasheets/1712178.pdf).
PCN 22_0241/22_0254: epoxy Henkel 8290 to 8290A for 8-lead SOIC, published 2022-10-12, lists LT1057/LT1058 parts (https://www.analog.com/media/en/PCN/ADI_PCN_22_0241_Rev_A_Form.pdf).

PDN 25_0024 lists LT1058ISW; PDN 25_0027 lists LT1057IS8 and LT1057IS8#TR with #PBF/#TRPBF replacements (https://shop.richardsonrfpd.com/docs/rfpd/ADI_PDN_25_0024.pdf, https://mm.digikey.com/Volume0/opasdata/d220001/medias/docus/7121/ADI_PDN_25_0027_Rev_-_Form.pdf).

DigiKey lists LT1058ISW obsolete; Ciiva lists LT1058CN#PBF in volume production (https://www.digikey.sg/en/products/detail/analog-devices-inc/LT1058ISW/296282, https://ciiva.com/part/lt1058cnpbf-1320373).
